verdict.rationale: cfo.ai is an AI-powered financial modeling service, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack covers integrations, MCP access, OAuth sign-in, changelogs and tool approval policies, but says nothing about whether customer data is used for model training or whether users can opt out. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
